description.name: Entry
description.text:
Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Twin Element Mode II (Wind, Poison)], Dual Awoken Tantalus Mode I, and [Wind/Poison Resonance +5% Boost] to the user
Dual Awoken Tantalus Mode I: Wind/Poison Ability Boost, Triplecast Wind/Poison & chases Wind/Poison abilities with 4 single-target Wind/Poison/NE physical attacks (0.50 each)

description.name: Twin Element Mode II (Wind, Poison)
description.text: Grants [Attach Wind with Stacking]/[Attach Poison with Stacking] after using a Wind/Poison ability

description.name: Wind/Poison Resonance +5% Boost
description.text: Wind and Poison abilities deal 5% more damage

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text:
Instant ATB 1 & Dual Awoken Tantalus Mode II to user
Dual Awoken Tantalus Mode II: Wind/Poison Ability Boost & chases a Wind/Poison ability with [Triplecast Wind/Poison, Wind/Poison Ability Damage +30% & Cap Break Level 2] for 1 turn to user
